description: This file defines C function prototypes for interacting with TPM (Trusted Platform Module) functionality, intended for use via Foreign Function Interface (FFI) from Rust code. It includes function declarations for TPM HMAC operations and logging, with external linkage specified for C compatibility.

methods.name: tpm_hmac
methods.description: Performs an HMAC operation with the TPM, returning 0 on success and 1 on error.

methods.name: secure_env_log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified severity, file, and line information.
